scope: Actual automatic-support paths for the rough full-shell manufacturing study
interpretation: All support paths lie at the wheel centre under the recessed screw-head seat. The only interface is at Z1.6-1.8 beneath its Z2.0 counterbore roof. No cap, sleeve, shell-end or keeper support paths.
decision: Keep an accessible small support under the counterbore in this study, rather than add a separate face cover or a proud fastener. Removal is through the outside 6mm opening; easy removal and bearing-face finish are physical unknowns, not qualified by this path location.
